d:
Shah Rukh Khan has reached out to his Josh co-star Sharad Kapoor during a difficult phase in his life. After watching Sharad's emotional video seeking work and support from the film industry, Shah Rukh called him and assured him of all possible help. Sharad has also received support from Sonu Sood, Salman Khan and other members of the film fraternity. From his health struggles and financial difficulties to his emotional bond with his pet dogs, here's what happened and why the actor is now hoping to make a comeback in films, television and OTT.
